_comment: Planned node configure --detail payload for listProductsByAttributeTerm1. Run once a WooCommerce IS connection exists. Replace <CONNECTION_ID> and <FOLDER_KEY>.
_dtl_note: attribute_term has design.loadByDefault=false — the Studio Web UI will render it as a dropdown that loads its options only on demand (after the user picks an 'attribute' value). The reference path is /attributes/terms?attribute_ID={attribute}. No change to the --detail payload is needed for this behaviour; it is driven by the connector metadata.
